spec.summary: Reads a fixed-width 13-character batch record containing amount, card network code, and transaction count. Computes a merchant fee as amount times network rate plus 0.10 per transaction, truncates decimals, caps the fee at 500.00 and at the amount itself, then prints the fee and net payout as edited numbers. If the amount is zero, prints an error message and stops.

inputs.name: WS-LINE
inputs.format: cols 1-13, PIC X(13), 13 characters of text

inputs.name: IN-AMOUNT
inputs.format: cols 1-9, PIC 9(7)V99, 7 integer digits with 2 implied decimals, no decimal point stored, zero-padded, unsigned

inputs.name: IN-NETWORK
inputs.format: col 10, PIC X, 1 character: V = Visa, M = Mastercard, A = Amex, any other uses default rate

inputs.name: IN-COUNT
inputs.format: cols 11-13, PIC 9(3), 3 integer digits, zero-padded, unsigned

outputs.name: ERROR line
outputs.format: Literal text "ERROR: EMPTY BATCH", 18 characters wide

outputs.name: FEE line
outputs.format: Literal "FEE: " followed by OUT-FEE edited by PIC Z(3)9.99, leading zeros suppressed to spaces, exactly 2 decimals shown, total line width 12 characters

outputs.name: NET line
outputs.format: Literal "NET: " followed by OUT-NET edited by PIC Z(6)9.99, leading zeros suppressed to spaces, exactly 2 decimals shown, total line width 15 characters

business_rules: If IN-AMOUNT equals 0, display "ERROR: EMPTY BATCH" and stop; no fee or net is calculated.
Network rate is selected by IN-NETWORK: V = 0.0195, M = 0.0215, A = 0.0350, any other value = 0.0299.
WS-FEE-RAW = IN-AMOUNT * WS-RATE + IN-COUNT * 0.10, computed with implied decimals and stored into PIC 9(6)V99 without ROUNDED, so any digits beyond 2 decimal places are truncated.
WS-FEE-RAW is moved to WS-FEE (PIC 9(4)V99); because WS-FEE is smaller, any high-order digits above 9999.99 are silently lost.
If WS-FEE is greater than 500, WS-FEE is set to 500 (stored as 500.00).
If WS-FEE is greater than IN-AMOUNT, WS-FEE is set to IN-AMOUNT.
WS-NET = IN-AMOUNT - WS-FEE, stored into PIC 9(7)V99 without ROUNDED; because WS-NET is unsigned, a negative result is stored without its sign.

OUT-FEE and OUT-NET are moved to their edited display fields; OUT-FEE uses PIC Z(3)9.99 (7 chars) and OUT-NET uses PIC Z(6)9.99 (10 chars), with leading zeros replaced by spaces and exactly two decimal digits shown.
edge_cases: Input "000000000V000": IN-AMOUNT is 0, so "ERROR: EMPTY BATCH" is displayed and the program stops.
Input "000010000X001": amount 100.00, network X uses default rate 0.0299 -> raw fee 2.99 + 0.10 = 3.09, fee 3.09, net 96.91.

Input "000000100V999": amount 1.00, count 999 -> raw fee 0.0195 + 99.90 = 99.9195, truncated to 99.91; fee 99.91, net negative -98.91 stored as 98.91 because WS-NET is unsigned; prints "FEE:   99.91" and "NET:    98.91".

Input "000000001V001": amount 0.01, rate 0.0195 -> product 0.000195, plus 0.10 = 0.100195, truncated to 0.10; fee 0.10, fee > amount so fee set to 0.01, net 0.00; prints "FEE:    0.01" and "NET:    0.00".
quirks: IN-AMOUNT PIC 9(7)V99 has an implied decimal point; the input columns contain only digits with no decimal point, e.g. cols 1-9 "000010000" mean 100.00, not 100000000.
WS-RATE PIC V9(4) has no integer digits; MOVE .0195 stores 0.0195 as 4 implied decimal digits.
COMPUTE WS-FEE-RAW at line 44 has no ROUNDED, so 12.339 is stored as 12.33, not 12.34.
COMPUTE WS-FEE-RAW has no ON SIZE ERROR; a result above 999999.99 silently loses its high-order digits.
MOVE WS-FEE-RAW TO WS-FEE at line 45 narrows from PIC 9(6)V99 to PIC 9(4)V99; values above 9999.99 lose their leftmost digits without error.
WS-FEE and WS-NET are unsigned (no S), so a negative computed result loses its sign and stores the absolute value.
COMPUTE WS-NET at line 52 has no ROUNDED and no ON SIZE ERROR; results above 9999999.99 lose high-order digits, and negative results are stored unsigned.
OUT-FEE PIC Z(3)9.99 suppresses leading zeros with spaces; 2.05 displays as "   2.05" (3 spaces, digit, decimal, 2 digits), exactly 7 characters.
OUT-NET PIC Z(6)9.99 suppresses leading zeros with spaces; 97.95 displays as "    97.95" (4 spaces, 2 digits, decimal, 2 digits), exactly 10 characters.
DISPLAY "FEE: " OUT-FEE concatenates the literal and edited field with no separator; the literal includes its trailing space.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. SETTLE.
      * Card settlement: merchant fee and net payout for one batch.
      * Input: one fixed-width line, 13 characters, no decimal points
      *   cols 1-9   batch amount in cents  (PIC 9(7)V99)
      *   col  10    card network   V = Visa, M = Mastercard, A = Amex
      *   cols 11-13 transactions   PIC 9(3)
      * Fee = amount * network rate + 0.10 per transaction,
      * rounded to the nearest cent, capped at 500.00.
      * (Changed 1998: record now read as text and split with MOVE;
      *  fee field shortened to 4 digits. -- R.K.)
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-LINE               PIC X(13).
       01  IN-AMOUNT             PIC 9(7)V99.
       01  IN-NETWORK            PIC X.
       01  IN-COUNT              PIC 9(3).
       01  WS-RATE               PIC V9(4).
       01  WS-FEE-RAW            PIC 9(6)V99.
       01  WS-FEE                PIC 9(4)V99.
       01  WS-NET                PIC 9(7)V99.
       01  OUT-FEE               PIC Z(3)9.99.
       01  OUT-NET               PIC Z(6)9.99.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           ACCEPT WS-LINE
           MOVE WS-LINE(1:9) TO IN-AMOUNT
           MOVE WS-LINE(10:1) TO IN-NETWORK
           MOVE WS-LINE(11:3) TO IN-COUNT
           IF IN-AMOUNT = 0
               DISPLAY "ERROR: EMPTY BATCH"
               STOP RUN
           END-IF
           EVALUATE IN-NETWORK
               WHEN 'V'
                   MOVE .0195 TO WS-RATE
               WHEN 'M'
                   MOVE .0215 TO WS-RATE
               WHEN 'A'
                   MOVE .0350 TO WS-RATE
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE .0299 TO WS-RATE
           END-EVALUATE
           COMPUTE WS-FEE-RAW = IN-AMOUNT * WS-RATE + IN-COUNT * 0.10
           MOVE WS-FEE-RAW TO WS-FEE
           IF WS-FEE > 500
               MOVE 500 TO WS-FEE
           END-IF
           IF WS-FEE > IN-AMOUNT
               MOVE IN-AMOUNT TO WS-FEE
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-NET = IN-AMOUNT - WS-FEE
           MOVE WS-FEE TO OUT-FEE
           MOVE WS-NET TO OUT-NET
           DISPLAY "FEE: " OUT-FEE
           DISPLAY "NET: " OUT-NET
           STOP RUN.

"""Module: settle

Python 3.11 migration of COBOL program SETTLE.
Byte-for-byte equivalent DISPLAY output for every input.
"""
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_DOWN, ROUND_HALF_UP
import re


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# COBOL data semantics helpers (copied verbatim per migration standard)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def pic_store(value, int_digits, dec_digits=0, signed=False, rounded=False):
    """Store a value into PIC [S]9(int_digits)V9(dec_digits), like COBOL MOVE/COMPUTE.

    - extra decimals are TRUNCATED (unless the COBOL statement says ROUNDED)
    - extra high-order integer digits are silently dropped (no ON SIZE ERROR)
    - unsigned fields drop the sign
    """
    q = Decimal(1).scaleb(-dec_digits)
    v = Decimal(value).quantize(q, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP if rounded else ROUND_DOWN)
    negative = v < 0
    v = (abs(v) % (Decimal(10) ** int_digits)).quantize(q)
    return -v if (negative and signed) else v


def pic_from_text(text, int_digits, dec_digits=0, signed=False):
    """Parse raw characters of a PIC 9 field read by ACCEPT (implied decimal point).
    '0012345' with dec_digits=2 -> Decimal('123.45'). Spaces count as zeros."""
    s = text.strip()
    negative = s.startswith("-") or s.endswith("-")
    digits = re.sub(r"[^0-9]", "", text.replace(" ", "0")) or "0"
    v = Decimal(int(digits)).scaleb(-dec_digits)
    return pic_store(-v if negative else v, int_digits, dec_digits, signed)


def split_fixed(line, widths):
    """Split an ACCEPTed line into fixed-width fields (group item layout).
    Short lines are padded with spaces, long lines are cut, like COBOL."""
    total = sum(widths)
    line = line[:total].ljust(total)
    out, pos = [], 0
    for w in widths:
        out.append(line[pos : pos + w])
        pos += w
    return out


def display_num(value, int_digits, dec_digits=0, signed=False):
    """How GnuCOBOL DISPLAYs an un-edited numeric field PIC [S]9(n)V9(m):
    leading zeros, '.' for the implied decimal, leading +/- if signed.
    e.g. PIC 9(3)V99 1.5 -> '001.50';  PIC S9(3) -7 -> '-007'."""
    v = pic_store(value, int_digits, dec_digits, signed)
    a = abs(v)
    int_part = int(a)
    s = str(int_part).zfill(int_digits)
    if dec_digits:
        frac = int((a - int_part).scaleb(dec_digits))
        s += "." + str(frac).zfill(dec_digits)
    if signed:
        s = ("-" if v < 0 else "+") + s
    return s


def _expand_pic(pic):
    return re.sub(r"(.)\((\d+)\)", lambda m: m.group(1) * int(m.group(2)), pic.upper())


def edit_picture(value, pic):
    """Format a value with a numeric-EDITED picture, e.g. 'Z,ZZZ,ZZ9.99', '-ZZ9.99',
    'ZZ9.99CR', '$ZZ,ZZ9.99', '9(5)'. Supports Z 9 , . + - CR DB and one fixed $.
    Truncates extra decimals and high-order digits exactly like a COBOL MOVE."""
    p = _expand_pic(pic)
    lead_sign = p[0] if p[:1] in "+-" else ""
    if lead_sign:
        p = p[1:]
    trail_sign = ""
    for t in ("CR", "DB", "+", "-"):
        if p.endswith(t):
            trail_sign, p = t, p[: -len(t)]
            break
    dollar = p.startswith("$")
    if dollar:
        p = p[1:]

    int_pat, _, dec_pat = p.partition(".")
    n_int = sum(c in "9Z" for c in int_pat)
    n_dec = sum(c in "9Z" for c in dec_pat)
    v = pic_store(value, n_int, n_dec, signed=True)
    negative = v < 0
    a = abs(v)
    int_digits = str(int(a)).zfill(n_int)
    dec_digits = str(int((a - int(a)).scaleb(n_dec))).zfill(n_dec) if n_dec else ""

    # integer part with zero suppression
    out, di, suppressing = [], 0, True
    for c in int_pat:
        if c in "9Z":
            d = int_digits[di]
            di += 1
            if c == "Z" and suppressing and d == "0":
                out.append(" ")
            else:
                suppressing = False
                out.append(d)
        elif c == ",":
            out.append(" " if suppressing else ",")
        else:
            out.append(c)
    body = "".join(out)

    if "9" not in p and a == 0:  # all-Z picture with zero value -> all blanks
        return " " * len(_expand_pic(pic))
    if dec_pat:
        body += "." + dec_digits

    if dollar:
        body = "$" + body
    if lead_sign:
        body = ("-" if negative else ("+" if lead_sign == "+" else " ")) + body
    if trail_sign in ("+", "-"):
        body += "-" if negative else ("+" if trail_sign == "+" else " ")
    elif trail_sign:
        body += trail_sign if negative else "  "
    return body


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Working-storage record for SETTLE
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class SettleRecord:
    """Holds all working-storage fields for one SETTLE run."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.ws_line: str = ""
        self.in_amount: Decimal = Decimal("0")      # PIC 9(7)V99
        self.in_network: str = ""                   # PIC X
        self.in_count: Decimal = Decimal("0")       # PIC 9(3)
        self.ws_rate: Decimal = Decimal("0")        # PIC V9(4)
        self.ws_fee_raw: Decimal = Decimal("0")     # PIC 9(6)V99
        self.ws_fee: Decimal = Decimal("0")         # PIC 9(4)V99
        self.ws_net: Decimal = Decimal("0")         # PIC 9(7)V99
        self.out_fee: str = ""                      # PIC Z(3)9.99
        self.out_net: str = ""                      # PIC Z(6)9.99


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main entry point
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main(input_line: str) -> str:
    """Return everything COBOL SETTLE would DISPLAY for one input line.

    Lines are joined by "\n" with NO trailing newline.
    Never raises.
    """
    rec = SettleRecord()

    # ACCEPT WS-LINE  (13-character fixed buffer)
    rec.ws_line = input_line[:13].ljust(13)

    # MOVE WS-LINE(1:9) TO IN-AMOUNT   PIC 9(7)V99, implied decimal
    # COBOL MOVE of text into a numeric field reads the digits as a whole number
    # with NO implied decimal: "000010000" -> 10000.00, then only the last 7
    # integer digits are kept (10000.00 -> 0000100.00 = 100.00).
    amt_text = rec.ws_line[0:9]
    amt_whole = Decimal(int(re.sub(r"[^0-9]", "", amt_text.replace(" ", "0")) or "0"))
    rec.in_amount = pic_store(amt_whole, int_digits=7, dec_digits=2, signed=False)

    # MOVE WS-LINE(10:1) TO IN-NETWORK  PIC X
    rec.in_network = rec.ws_line[9:10]

    # MOVE WS-LINE(11:3) TO IN-COUNT   PIC 9(3)
    rec.in_count = pic_from_text(rec.ws_line[10:13], int_digits=3, dec_digits=0)

    # IF IN-AMOUNT = 0  DISPLAY "ERROR: EMPTY BATCH"  STOP RUN
    if rec.in_amount == Decimal("0"):
        return "ERROR: EMPTY BATCH"

    # EVALUATE IN-NETWORK  select rate into WS-RATE (PIC V9(4), 4 implied decimals)
    if rec.in_network == "V":
        rec.ws_rate = Decimal("0.0195")
    elif rec.in_network == "M":
        rec.ws_rate = Decimal("0.0215")
    elif rec.in_network == "A":
        rec.ws_rate = Decimal("0.0350")
    else:
        rec.ws_rate = Decimal("0.0299")

    # COMPUTE WS-FEE-RAW = IN-AMOUNT * WS-RATE + IN-COUNT * 0.10
    # Stored into PIC 9(6)V99 without ROUNDED -> decimals beyond 2 are truncated.
    raw = rec.in_amount * rec.ws_rate + rec.in_count * Decimal("0.10")
    rec.ws_fee_raw = pic_store(raw, int_digits=6, dec_digits=2, signed=False)

    # MOVE WS-FEE-RAW TO WS-FEE   PIC 9(4)V99  (narrows; high-order digits lost)
    rec.ws_fee = pic_store(rec.ws_fee_raw, int_digits=4, dec_digits=2, signed=False)

    # IF WS-FEE > 500  MOVE 500 TO WS-FEE   (stored as 500.00)
    if rec.ws_fee > Decimal("500"):
        rec.ws_fee = pic_store(Decimal("500"), int_digits=4, dec_digits=2, signed=False)

    # IF WS-FEE > IN-AMOUNT  MOVE IN-AMOUNT TO WS-FEE
    if rec.ws_fee > rec.in_amount:
        rec.ws_fee = pic_store(rec.in_amount, int_digits=4, dec_digits=2, signed=False)

    # COMPUTE WS-NET = IN-AMOUNT - WS-FEE   PIC 9(7)V99, unsigned
    # Negative results lose their sign; high-order digits above 9999999.99 are dropped.
    rec.ws_net = pic_store(rec.in_amount - rec.ws_fee, int_digits=7, dec_digits=2, signed=False)

    # MOVE WS-FEE TO OUT-FEE   PIC Z(3)9.99
    rec.out_fee = edit_picture(rec.ws_fee, "Z(3)9.99")

    # MOVE WS-NET TO OUT-NET   PIC Z(6)9.99
    rec.out_net = edit_picture(rec.ws_net, "Z(6)9.99")

    # DISPLAY "FEE: " OUT-FEE   (literal includes trailing space, no separator)
    fee_line = "FEE: " + rec.out_fee

    # DISPLAY "NET: " OUT-NET
    net_line = "NET: " + rec.out_net

    return fee_line + "\n" + net_line


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Allow direct execution: python settle.py < input.txt
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys

    line = sys.stdin.readline()
    # Strip only the trailing newline; COBOL ACCEPT keeps everything else.
    if line.endswith("\n"):
        line = line[:-1]
    if line.endswith("\r"):
        line = line[:-1]
    print(main(line), end="")

    # MOVE WS-FEE-RAW TO WS-FEE   PIC 9(4)V99  (narrows; high-order digits lost)
    rec.ws_fee = pic_store(rec.ws_fee_raw, int_digits=4, dec_digits=2, signed=False)

    # IF WS-FEE > 500  MOVE 500 TO WS-FEE   (stored as 500.00)
    if rec.ws_fee > Decimal("500"):
        rec.ws_fee = pic_store(Decimal("500"), int_digits=4, dec_digits=2, signed=False)

    # IF WS-FEE > IN-AMOUNT  MOVE IN-AMOUNT TO WS-FEE
    if rec.ws_fee > rec.in_amount:
        rec.ws_fee = pic_store(rec.in_amount, int_digits=4, dec_digits=2, signed=False)

    # COMPUTE WS-NET = IN-AMOUNT - WS-FEE   PIC 9(7)V99, unsigned
    # Negative results lose their sign; high-order digits above 9999999.99 are dropped.
    rec.ws_net = pic_store(rec.in_amount - rec.ws_fee, int_digits=7, dec_digits=2, signed=False)

    # MOVE WS-FEE TO OUT-FEE   PIC Z(3)9.99
    rec.out_fee = edit_picture(rec.ws_fee, "Z(3)9.99")

    # MOVE WS-NET TO OUT-NET   PIC Z(6)9.99
    rec.out_net = edit_picture(rec.ws_net, "Z(6)9.99")

    # DISPLAY "FEE: " OUT-FEE   (literal includes trailing space, no separator)
    fee_line = "FEE: " + rec.out_fee

    # DISPLAY "NET: " OUT-NET
    net_line = "NET: " + rec.out_net

    return fee_line + "\n" + net_line

"""Module: settle

Python 3.11 migration of COBOL program SETTLE.
Byte-for-byte equivalent DISPLAY output for every input.
"""
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_DOWN, ROUND_HALF_UP
import re


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# COBOL data semantics helpers (copied verbatim per migration standard)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def pic_store(value, int_digits, dec_digits=0, signed=False, rounded=False):
    """Store a value into PIC [S]9(int_digits)V9(dec_digits), like COBOL MOVE/COMPUTE.

    - extra decimals are TRUNCATED (unless the COBOL statement says ROUNDED)
    - extra high-order integer digits are silently dropped (no ON SIZE ERROR)
    - unsigned fields drop the sign
    """
    q = Decimal(1).scaleb(-dec_digits)
    v = Decimal(value).quantize(q, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP if rounded else ROUND_DOWN)
    negative = v < 0
    v = (abs(v) % (Decimal(10) ** int_digits)).quantize(q)
    return -v if (negative and signed) else v


def pic_from_text(text, int_digits, dec_digits=0, signed=False):
    """Parse raw characters of a PIC 9 field read by ACCEPT (implied decimal point).
    '0012345' with dec_digits=2 -> Decimal('123.45'). Spaces count as zeros."""
    s = text.strip()
    negative = s.startswith("-") or s.endswith("-")
    digits = re.sub(r"[^0-9]", "", text.replace(" ", "0")) or "0"
    v = Decimal(int(digits)).scaleb(-dec_digits)
    return pic_store(-v if negative else v, int_digits, dec_digits, signed)


def split_fixed(line, widths):
    """Split an ACCEPTed line into fixed-width fields (group item layout).
    Short lines are padded with spaces, long lines are cut, like COBOL."""
    total = sum(widths)
    line = line[:total].ljust(total)
    out, pos = [], 0
    for w in widths:
        out.append(line[pos : pos + w])
        pos += w
    return out


def display_num(value, int_digits, dec_digits=0, signed=False):
    """How GnuCOBOL DISPLAYs an un-edited numeric field PIC [S]9(n)V9(m):
    leading zeros, '.' for the implied decimal, leading +/- if signed.
    e.g. PIC 9(3)V99 1.5 -> '001.50';  PIC S9(3) -7 -> '-007'."""
    v = pic_store(value, int_digits, dec_digits, signed)
    a = abs(v)
    int_part = int(a)
    s = str(int_part).zfill(int_digits)
    if dec_digits:
        frac = int((a - int_part).scaleb(dec_digits))
        s += "." + str(frac).zfill(dec_digits)
    if signed:
        s = ("-" if v < 0 else "+") + s
    return s


def _expand_pic(pic):
    return re.sub(r"(.)\((\d+)\)", lambda m: m.group(1) * int(m.group(2)), pic.upper())


def edit_picture(value, pic):
    """Format a value with a numeric-EDITED picture, e.g. 'Z,ZZZ,ZZ9.99', '-ZZ9.99',
    'ZZ9.99CR', '$ZZ,ZZ9.99', '9(5)'. Supports Z 9 , . + - CR DB and one fixed $.
    Truncates extra decimals and high-order digits exactly like a COBOL MOVE."""
    p = _expand_pic(pic)
    lead_sign = p[0] if p[:1] in "+-" else ""
    if lead_sign:
        p = p[1:]
    trail_sign = ""
    for t in ("CR", "DB", "+", "-"):
        if p.endswith(t):
            trail_sign, p = t, p[: -len(t)]
            break
    dollar = p.startswith("$")
    if dollar:
        p = p[1:]

    int_pat, _, dec_pat = p.partition(".")
    n_int = sum(c in "9Z" for c in int_pat)
    n_dec = sum(c in "9Z" for c in dec_pat)
    v = pic_store(value, n_int, n_dec, signed=True)
    negative = v < 0
    a = abs(v)
    int_digits = str(int(a)).zfill(n_int)
    dec_digits = str(int((a - int(a)).scaleb(n_dec))).zfill(n_dec) if n_dec else ""

    # integer part with zero suppression
    out, di, suppressing = [], 0, True
    for c in int_pat:
        if c in "9Z":
            d = int_digits[di]
            di += 1
            if c == "Z" and suppressing and d == "0":
                out.append(" ")
            else:
                suppressing = False
                out.append(d)
        elif c == ",":
            out.append(" " if suppressing else ",")
        else:
            out.append(c)
    body = "".join(out)

    if "9" not in p and a == 0:  # all-Z picture with zero value -> all blanks
        return " " * len(_expand_pic(pic))
    if dec_pat:
        body += "." + dec_digits

    if dollar:
        body = "$" + body
    if lead_sign:
        body = ("-" if negative else ("+" if lead_sign == "+" else " ")) + body
    if trail_sign in ("+", "-"):
        body += "-" if negative else ("+" if trail_sign == "+" else " ")
    elif trail_sign:
        body += trail_sign if negative else "  "
    return body


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Working-storage record for SETTLE
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class SettleRecord:
    """Holds all working-storage fields for one SETTLE run."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.ws_line: str = ""
        self.in_amount: Decimal = Decimal("0")      # PIC 9(7)V99
        self.in_network: str = ""                   # PIC X
        self.in_count: Decimal = Decimal("0")       # PIC 9(3)
        self.ws_rate: Decimal = Decimal("0")        # PIC V9(4)
        self.ws_fee_raw: Decimal = Decimal("0")     # PIC 9(6)V99
        self.ws_fee: Decimal = Decimal("0")         # PIC 9(4)V99
        self.ws_net: Decimal = Decimal("0")         # PIC 9(7)V99
        self.out_fee: str = ""                      # PIC Z(3)9.99
        self.out_net: str = ""                      # PIC Z(6)9.99


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main entry point
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main(input_line: str) -> str:
    """Return everything COBOL SETTLE would DISPLAY for one input line.

    Lines are joined by "\n" with NO trailing newline.
    Never raises.
    """
    rec = SettleRecord()

    # ACCEPT WS-LINE  (13-character fixed buffer)
    rec.ws_line = input_line[:13].ljust(13)

    # MOVE WS-LINE(1:9) TO IN-AMOUNT   PIC 9(7)V99, implied decimal
    # COBOL MOVE of text into a numeric field reads the digits as a whole number
    # with NO implied decimal: "000010000" -> 10000.00, then only the last 7
    # integer digits are kept (10000.00 -> 0000100.00 = 100.00).
    amt_text = rec.ws_line[0:9]
    amt_whole = Decimal(int(re.sub(r"[^0-9]", "", amt_text.replace(" ", "0")) or "0"))
    rec.in_amount = pic_store(amt_whole, int_digits=7, dec_digits=2, signed=False)

    # MOVE WS-LINE(10:1) TO IN-NETWORK  PIC X
    rec.in_network = rec.ws_line[9:10]

    # MOVE WS-LINE(11:3) TO IN-COUNT   PIC 9(3)
    rec.in_count = pic_from_text(rec.ws_line[10:13], int_digits=3, dec_digits=0)

    # IF IN-AMOUNT = 0  DISPLAY "ERROR: EMPTY BATCH"  STOP RUN
    if rec.in_amount == Decimal("0"):
        return "ERROR: EMPTY BATCH"

    # EVALUATE IN-NETWORK  select rate into WS-RATE (PIC V9(4), 4 implied decimals)
    if rec.in_network == "V":
        rec.ws_rate = Decimal("0.0195")
    elif rec.in_network == "M":
        rec.ws_rate = Decimal("0.0215")
    elif rec.in_network == "A":
        rec.ws_rate = Decimal("0.0350")
    else:
        rec.ws_rate = Decimal("0.0299")

    # COMPUTE WS-FEE-RAW = IN-AMOUNT * WS-RATE + IN-COUNT * 0.10
    # Stored into PIC 9(6)V99 without ROUNDED -> decimals beyond 2 are truncated.
    raw = rec.in_amount * rec.ws_rate + rec.in_count * Decimal("0.10")
    rec.ws_fee_raw = pic_store(raw, int_digits=6, dec_digits=2, signed=False)

    # MOVE WS-FEE-RAW TO WS-FEE   PIC 9(4)V99  (narrows; high-order digits lost)
    rec.ws_fee = pic_store(rec.ws_fee_raw, int_digits=4, dec_digits=2, signed=False)

    # IF WS-FEE > 500  MOVE 500 TO WS-FEE   (stored as 500.00)
    if rec.ws_fee > Decimal("500"):
        rec.ws_fee = pic_store(Decimal("500"), int_digits=4, dec_digits=2, signed=False)

    # IF WS-FEE > IN-AMOUNT  MOVE IN-AMOUNT TO WS-FEE
    if rec.ws_fee > rec.in_amount:
        rec.ws_fee = pic_store(rec.in_amount, int_digits=4, dec_digits=2, signed=False)

    # COMPUTE WS-NET = IN-AMOUNT - WS-FEE   PIC 9(7)V99, unsigned
    # Negative results lose their sign; high-order digits above 9999999.99 are dropped.
    rec.ws_net = pic_store(rec.in_amount - rec.ws_fee, int_digits=7, dec_digits=2, signed=False)

    # MOVE WS-FEE TO OUT-FEE   PIC Z(3)9.99
    rec.out_fee = edit_picture(rec.ws_fee, "Z(3)9.99")

    # MOVE WS-NET TO OUT-NET   PIC Z(6)9.99
    rec.out_net = edit_picture(rec.ws_net, "Z(6)9.99")

    # DISPLAY "FEE: " OUT-FEE   (literal includes trailing space, no separator)
    fee_line = "FEE: " + rec.out_fee

    # DISPLAY "NET: " OUT-NET
    net_line = "NET: " + rec.out_net

    return fee_line + "\n" + net_line
